title: Timing of Billing-Error Make-Goods on Wayfare Rides Fares
content:
The timeliness factor applied to the make-good on a **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** fare charge billed above the guaranteed fare counts the calendar days from the charge date of the fare charge to today.

| Calendar days from the fare charge date to today | Timeliness factor |
|---|---|
| 21 or more (late-request days) | 0.5 (late timeliness factor) |
| at least 11 (mid-request days) and fewer than 21 | 0.75 (mid timeliness factor) |
| fewer than 11 | not reduced |

At least 21 days take the late timeliness factor of 0.5; at least 11 days but fewer than 21 take the mid timeliness factor of 0.75; fewer than 11 days leave the timeliness factor unreduced.

## Counting the days

The count is the number of calendar days between the charge date and today: a fare charged on the 3rd of a month is 11 days old on the 14th of the same month.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, fare charged on 3 May)

| Today | Days | Factor |
|---|---|---|
| 13 May | 10 | not reduced |
| 14 May | 11 | 0.75 |
| 23 May | 20 | 0.75 |
| 24 May | 21 | 0.5 |
